name: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind
description: One of the most technologically groundbreaking roller coasters ever built — Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind is a reverse-launch indoor coaster with a unique omnimover system that rotates vehicles to face the action throughout the ride. Set to a legendary 70s and 80s soundtrack and featuring incredible immersive pre-show, this is the most innovative and talked-about new attraction at Walt Disney World. Min 122cm.

name: Test Track
description: A classic EPCOT icon — Test Track places guests inside a SimCar vehicle and subjects it to extreme temperature, terrain and speed tests before a thrilling high-speed run around the outside of the pavilion reaching 100 km/h. One of the most beloved and rerideable attractions at EPCOT and a Walt Disney World institution. Min 102cm.

name: Soarin' Around the World
description: A breathtaking hang-glider simulation soaring over the world's most spectacular landscapes — Soarin' Around the World at EPCOT immerses riders in sweeping wind, authentic scents and a giant circular screen projection of extraordinary global destinations. One of the most beloved and peaceful attractions at Walt Disney World. Min 102cm.

name: Frozen Ever After
description: A delightful and beautifully themed boat ride through the magical kingdom of Arendelle — Frozen Ever After brings the world of Frozen to life with extraordinary Audio-Animatronic figures of Elsa, Anna and friends, original music and stunning Norwegian-inspired theming. The most popular family attraction in the World Showcase. Suitable for all ages.

name: Mission: SPACE
description: The most intense simulator attraction at any Disney park — Mission: SPACE places guests inside a centrifuge-based spacecraft simulator that delivers real g-forces during a simulated launch and orbit mission. Available in Orange (intense) and Green (gentle) missions. An extraordinary and genuinely unique theme park experience. Min 112cm.

name: Remy's Ratatouille Adventure
description: A charming and elaborately themed trackless dark ride that shrinks guests to the size of a rat and sends them scurrying through the kitchens and dining rooms of Gusteau's restaurant. Remy's Ratatouille Adventure features beautiful French theming, playful Audio-Animatronics and is one of the most beloved family dark rides at Walt Disney World. Suitable for all ages.

name: Living with the Land
description: A serene and genuinely educational boat ride through EPCOT's real working greenhouses and aquaculture facilities — Living with the Land showcases innovative sustainable farming methods actually used to grow food served in EPCOT restaurants. One of the most unique and quietly fascinating attractions at any Disney park. Suitable for all ages.

name: Journey Into Imagination with Figment
description: A classic EPCOT original featuring the beloved purple dragon Figment — Journey Into Imagination takes guests through the Imagination Institute on a colourful and sensory journey celebrating creativity and imagination. Figment is one of the most beloved original Disney characters created specifically for EPCOT. Suitable for all ages.

name: World Showcase
description: The most culturally immersive theme park experience in the world — World Showcase is an extraordinary 1.2-mile promenade around World Showcase Lagoon featuring eleven pavilions representing countries including France, Japan, Italy, Morocco, China, Norway, Mexico, Germany, Canada, UK and America. Each pavilion features authentic architecture, food, entertainment and merchandise. Suitable for all ages.

name: Canada Pavilion
description: One of the most beautifully designed pavilions in World Showcase — Canada features stunning Victorian architecture, a gorgeous garden, the beloved O Canada! CircleVision 360 film and an outstanding steakhouse. A must-visit pavilion in the EPCOT World Showcase. Suitable for all ages.

name: France Pavilion
description: The most beloved World Showcase pavilion — France features authentic Parisian architecture, the beautiful Impressions de France film, the spectacular Remy's Ratatouille Adventure dark ride, a genuine boulangerie and some of the finest dining in all of Walt Disney World. Suitable for all ages.

name: Japan Pavilion
description: One of the most architecturally stunning pavilions in World Showcase — Japan features a breathtaking replica of the Torii Gate, an extraordinary Japanese garden, a Mitsukoshi department store with authentic Japanese goods and some of the best Japanese dining at Walt Disney World. Suitable for all ages.

name: Mexico Pavilion
description: The most unique World Showcase pavilion — Mexico is housed inside a spectacular Mayan pyramid and features a beautiful indoor plaza, the Gran Fiesta Tour boat ride, an authentic Mexican market and some of the most atmospheric dining in World Showcase. Suitable for all ages.
